🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: Financials XLF (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +4.79%) ABOVE TREND and Small caps IWM (1W: +3.00% | 1M: +2.22%) ABOVE TREND, while HYG/LQD shows credit stress RISING (HYG (1W: +0.21% | 1M: +0.64%) ABOVE TREND; LQD (1W: -0.10% | 1M: +0.11%) CORRECTION).

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress RISING: HYG/LQD ↓ (see HYG and LQD above). Fear relatively subdued/complacent: VXX (1W: +0.61% | 1M: -13.93%) RECOVERY and VIX (1W: -0.11% | 1M: -14.93%) BELOW TREND; Stocks vs Bonds near neutral with SPY (1W: +0.37% | 1M: +0.86%) ABOVE TREND and TLT (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -0.04%) BELOW TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral to mildly restrictive: Dollar ↑ rising (Dollar Strength 1W: +0.63% | 1M: +0.03%) ABOVE TREND, TLT (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -0.04%) BELOW TREND and Yield Curve in RECOVERY (1W: +0.64% | 1M: -0.19%).

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals and materials leadership: XLB (1W: +2.08% | 1M: +6.42%) ABOVE TREND, XME (1W: +9.01% | 1M: +14.61%) ABOVE TREND and XLF (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +4.79%) ABOVE TREND. Tech mixed: XLK (1W: +0.77% | 1M: +0.10%) ABOVE TREND while QQQ (1W: +0.74% | 1M: -0.10%) RECOVERY, signaling sector rotation not broad tech collapse; Style: cyclicals/value showing relative strength.

5. US vs Global?
US holding: SPY (1W: +0.37% | 1M: +0.86%) ABOVE TREND. EM strength: EEM (1W: +3.59% | 1M: +5.34%) ABOVE TREND and China FXI (1W: +1.58% | 1M: -0.46%) RECOVERY — emerging markets leading modestly vs US.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Spec risk active in pockets: ARKK (1W: +4.20% | 1M: -0.94%) RECOVERY, IBIT (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +1.68%) ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +3.00% | 1M: +2.22%) ABOVE TREND indicate selective appetite for higher beta.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Precious metals surging: PPLT (1W: +5.46% | 1M: +39.92%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +34.01%) ABOVE TREND and GLD (1W: +2.59% | 1M: +5.90%) ABOVE TREND; industrial metals strong: CPER (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.68%) ABOVE TREND.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy mixed-to-weak: XLE (1W: +0.38% | 1M: -0.88%) RECOVERY while oil proxies BNO (1W: -1.72% | 1M: -4.76%) BELOW TREND and natural gas UNG (1W: -10.21% | 1M: -28.04%) BELOW TREND.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Financials XLF and Small caps IWM both timeframes positive (XLF ABOVE TREND; IWM ABOVE TREND). DIVERGENCE: QQQ (1W: +0.74% | 1M: -0.10%) RECOVERY and FXI (1W: +1.58% | 1M: -0.46%) RECOVERY are minor divergences—monitor for broader unwind.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclicals/value exposure (XLF (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +4.79%) ABOVE TREND, XLB (1W: +2.08% | 1M: +6.42%) ABOVE TREND) and maintain selective risk in EM and small caps; reduce exposure to defensives XLU (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -2.58%) BELOW TREND and monitor credit (HYG/LQD).

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Materials XLB (1W: +2.08% | 1M: +6.42%) ABOVE TREND, Industrials/Industrial ETFs like XME (1W: +9.01% | 1M: +14.61%) ABOVE TREND, Biotech XBI (1W: +3.91% | 1M: +2.79%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Utilities XLU (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -2.58%) BELOW TREND and Consumer Staples (sector 1W: -3.10% | 1M: -2.36%) showing weakness.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Precious metals PPLT (1W: +5.46% | 1M: +39.92%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +34.01%) ABOVE TREND; BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -10.21% | 1M: -28.04%) BELOW TREND and oil proxies BNO (1W: -1.72% | 1M: -4.76%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 26.44 (VXX complacency/watch); HYG/LQD 0.7316 (credit health; HYG/LQD ↓); Tech vs Financials ratio XLK/XLF 2.6350 (rotation watch); SPY (1W: +0.37% | 1M: +0.86%) ABOVE TREND as market tape anchor.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, supported by XLF (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +4.79%) ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +3.00% | 1M: +2.22%) ABOVE TREND. Materials and Industrials showing relative strength (XLB (1W: +2.08% | 1M: +6.42%) ABOVE TREND; XME (1W: +9.01% | 1M: +14.61%) ABOVE TREND) while credit stress rising (HYG/LQD ↓) and QQQ (1W: +0.74% | 1M: -0.10%) RECOVERY are key divergences to monitor.
